newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria Jan unemployment 4.1 pct. [CORRECTED 12:30 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Austria Jan unemployment 4.1 pct. [CORRECTED 12:30 GMT]

text.p: The Social Affairs Ministry reported the following economic indicator details.

NOTE - The January 1997 and December 1996 figures were calculated according to European Union standards. The January 1996 figure is not directly comparable. The January 1997 figure is an extrapolation by the Austrian Labour Market Service from final Eurostat data for November. (Corrects to read in headline and first paragraph the January unemployment percentage figure as 4.1 percent from 4.0 percent.
Also corrects footnote to make clear that the January 1977 figure is an extrapolation by the Austrian Labour Market Service (AMS) from final Eurostat data for November)
